description: This file contains the implementation of sorting functionality for FooTable, a jQuery plugin for HTML tables. It defines classes, methods, and event handling related to sorting columns, including sorting logic, UI updates, and integration with table data.

classes.name: F.Sorter
classes.description: Represents a sorting instruction with a specific column and direction.

classes.name: F.Sorting
classes.description: A component that adds sorting capabilities to FooTable, including UI controls, sorting logic, and event handling.

methods.name: F.Sorting#preinit
methods.description: Checks the supplied data and options for the sorting component before initialization.

methods.name: F.Sorting#init
methods.description: Initializes the sorting component, setting up UI and event handlers.

methods.name: F.Sorting#destroy
methods.description: Removes UI elements and event handlers related to sorting.

methods.name: F.Sorting#predraw
methods.description: Performs sorting of table rows based on the current sorted column.

methods.name: F.Sorting#draw
methods.description: Updates the sorting UI indicators to reflect the current sorted column and direction.

methods.name: F.Sorting#sort
methods.description: Sets the sorting options and triggers table redraw.

methods.name: F.Sorting#hasChanged
methods.description: Checks if the sorting state has changed from the initial state.

methods.name: F.Sorting#reset
methods.description: Resets the table to its initial sorting state.

methods.name: _sort
methods.description: Handles the sorting process, raising events before and after sorting.

methods.name: _onSortClicked
methods.description: Event handler for user clicking on a sortable column header.
